summary.text: Eric Armstrong is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 20, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent against Republican Keith Jones.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary, and Ballotpedia lists the Iowa Federation of Labor, AFL-CIO among his endorsements.
